text: Arshad Sauleh (Urdu: ارشر صالح) is an artist and radio broadcaster from a Muslim family, born in Srinagar, the summer capital of Kashmir. He has served as a host and judge in several prominent art exhibitions and is currently teaching art at the Government College of Education in Srinagar. Arshad Sauleh represented India at the 2002 International Exhibition of Quranic paintings in Iran and was honored by the Ministry of Heritage and Islamic Guidance, Government of Iran, for his participation in the tenth International Exhibition on Quranic Paintings. This recognition occurred during the period of the Kashmir conflict.
